scope: Analytical HBROM contributor; no RTL edits, simulation or physical jobs. Local predecessor evidence is not HBROM parent closure.

clocks.related_scope: Same-die single PLL only. Separate die PLLs require independently qualified link CDC.

rom.basis: Calibrated analytical Liberty generator, historical274bit macro; no-ECC successor width requires new characterized contract
rom.rule: Local capture adjacent to macro required; no bank mux/large wire before capture can be assumed to fit residual. Price a new full cycle for registered bank selection and each transport stage.
rom.slot_alternation_note: Two4096 halves restore8192-depth capacity; alternation does not imply two usable words/cycle. Actual port schedule governs.

cdc.minimum_slow_width_formula: ceil(4*Wfast/3), rounded to actual payload/alignment; requires explicit width converter
cdc.bit_state_formula: 2*DEPTH*W data/shadow flops, plus pointer/state/reset flops; shadow captures every destination cycle
cdc.boundary_track_floor_formula: DEPTH*W + 2*(ceil(log2(DEPTH))+1) +4 crossed pointer/state wires; excludes shielding, clocks, power and external buses
cdc.credit: Every read increments rp; sampled back at next strict write edge. Writer ready uses sampled rp. Depth4 sustains0.9Gword/s in both directions; arbitrary downstream stalls require producer throttling, cannot hide unbounded backlog.
cdc.reset: Whole FIFO epoch flush; synchronous per-domain resets with upstream reset synchronizers; DOWN/WAIT/RUN handshake and HOLD>=1 (default2). No data accepted until peer live. Reset-flushed in-flight work must be replayed at transaction layer.
cdc.gating: Peer state/pointer sampling must remain clocked during reset recovery and pending credit. Gate datapath only with explicit wake/drain protocol; stale credits or missed DOWN pulses are incorrect.
cdc.legacy: Do not reuse rtl/chip/ot_chip_v41_ratio_fifo.sv: recorded SS setup failure -75.59ps; older4slow/5fast model is conservative latency but does not cure failed implementation.

requirements: Count local ROM capture registers before weight mux, register bank mux outputs, and count every transport pipeline stage.
Reserve physical rows and routing for ICG, CTS buffers, reset synchronization, FIFO shadow state, credit/status wires, isolation/power control and hold repair.
Include clock spine and gated leaf capacitance in power; no ideal zero idle-clock assumption.
Use actual routing layers and subtract power straps, clocks and blockages before boundary track fit.
Clock gate ROM and local capture per active bank group. More sharing increases selection/fanout network and active clock load.
Hub links to slow compute incur full CDC service and width-conversion costs; weights feeding1.2GHz matrix tiles do not incur unnecessary slow-domain crossings.
SS/FF closure must include capture, mux, CDC and full cluster interconnect; standalone FIFO pass does not prove parent closure.
floorplan.quantitative_cts_reservation: Unknown until selected cluster floorplan/inventory; do not invent fixed overhead or transfer old full-die clock watts.
floorplan.conservative_latency_composition: 1fast ROM capture + mux/register and transport cycles + 2slow when crossing f2s + measured compute dependency +2fast when crossing s2f; CDC service serialization and stalls charged separately.

recommendation: Keep streaming reusable matrix compute with ROM in1.2GHz domain, place serial SU/reducers0.9GHz adjacent. Use predecessor CDC only as measured reusable primitive and qualify required widths in context.
